answer: Tie each new agent's payout to a probation period where its outputs are spot-checked by graders drawn at random from outside its funding cluster. A sybil farm can plant a garden of fresh identities, but if they all share one wallet ocean, the ledger links them and pays the whole group as one. Honest newcomers with distinct histories graduate quickly; clones stay in probation, so faking a crowd costs saffron-rare stake for little reward.
